title: Lugano Peninsula & Alpe Vicania
subtitle: MTB adventure with panoramic lake views
intro: From our shop, we ride along the lakeshore towards Paradiso before tackling the climb into the forest trail. This MTB tour blends nature, fun and adrenaline, offering breathtaking views across the entire Gulf of Lugano.

Along the route we visit the Madonna d’Ongero church, ride through chestnut forests, reach Alpe Vicania and cross the iconic San Grato Botanical Park — famous for its botanical variety and unforgettable lake-and-mountain views.
The tour includes some technical sections and is designed for riders with good bike handling skills.
highlights: Stunnings lake views
17th-century church of Madonna d’Ongero
San Grato Botanical Park
Authentic Ticino villages
Epic photo spots

title: Asiago – Bike Adventure
subtitle: 3 Days | Mountain Biking in the Heart of the Asiago Plateau
intro: Three days of mountain biking through gravel roads, historic military tracks, forests and high-altitude pastures, exploring one of the most fascinating areas of the Venetian Prealps.
A journey combining nature and history, following ancient routes shaped by the First World War, with overnight stays between Asiago and the surrounding mountains.
highlights: Città di Roccia and Monte Fior – spectacular limestone formations surrounded by high-altitude pastures.
Strada della Granatiera – an extraordinary historic military road carved into the rock.
WWI heritage – mule tracks, trenches and fortifications that tell the story of the Great War.
Endless gravel riding – kilometres of beautiful unpaved roads through stunning mountain landscapes.
Almost traffic-free – enjoy peaceful riding away from busy roads.
Local flavours – traditional mountain huts, local cuisine and, of course, the famous Asiago cheese.

title: Bike Shuttle Service
subtitle: Reach the best mountain bike trails around Lugano without the climb
intro: Our bike shuttle service in Lugano provides easy access to some of the best mountain bike trails in Ticino. Instead of long and tiring climbs, we transport riders and their bikes directly to selected trailheads in the mountains around Lugano, allowing you to maximize your time on the trails and enjoy longer descents.

This service is ideal for mountain bikers who want to explore the region’s natural trails, discover new routes and ride more efficiently during their day in Ticino. Whether you are visiting the region for a few days or planning a dedicated MTB trip, our shuttle helps you reach some of the most scenic and enjoyable trails around Lugano.
2wheels Rental combines local knowledge of the terrain with reliable transport to help riders experience the best mountain biking that Lugano and Ticino have to offer.

title: Monte Brè & Alpe Bolla
subtitle: Scenic e-bike climb with local Grotto lunch option
intro: A panoramic e-bike experience connecting Monte Brè with the peaceful forest of Alpe Bolla.

Starting directly from our shop, we ride all the long lake to the start of the climbing on scenic asphalt roads toward the charming village of Brè, enjoying continuous views over the Gulf of Lugano. The village itself is known for its artistic character and open-air sculptures, making it a perfect cultural stop along the way.

From there, the route continues through forest roads and gravel trails toward Alpe Bolla, located at the foot of Monte Boglia. Surrounded by alpine meadows and open mountain scenery, it’s an ideal spot for a traditional mountain lunch before descending back to Lugano via flowing gravel roads and easy singletrack.
An ideal balance between effort and reward — the e-bike assistance makes the climb enjoyable while preserving the true mountain experience.
highlights: Summit area of Monte Brè
Aperitivo with a stunning lake view
Brè artistic old village
Pre-Alpine landscapes at Alpe Bolla
The best view over the Gulf of Lugano
Traditional local mountain lunch

title: Monte Brè Panorama Ride
subtitle: E-bike climb to Lugano’s most iconic viewpoint
intro: A classic Lugano ride combining steady climbing, forest trails and one of the most breathtaking panoramas in Ticino. From our shop, we warm up along the lake before starting the ascent towards Monte Brè, known as one of Switzerland’s sunniest mountains.

The route climbs through quiet roads and chestnut forests before reaching the charming village of Brè and the spectacular summit viewpoint. From the top, the panorama opens across Lake Lugano, Monte Rosa on clear days, and the surrounding Alpine peaks.
Depending on the group and bike type, we can descend via flowing MTB trails or scenic panoramic roads — making this tour ideal for both e-bike riders and skilled e-MTB enthusiasts.
highlights: Summit of Monte Brè
The best view over the Gulf of Lugano
Panoramic terrace over Lake Lugano
Aperitivo with a stunning lake view
Brè old village

title: Ceresio Bike Loop
subtitle: Scenic road bike or e-bike tour around Lake Lugano
intro: A spectacular full loop around Lake Lugano, combining lakeside cycling, charming villages and Mediterranean atmosphere. Starting from our shop in Lugano, we follow the shoreline south towards Paradiso and Melide before crossing into Italy and riding along the quieter eastern side of the lake.

One of the highlights is the postcard-perfect village of Morcote, often considered one of the most beautiful villages in Switzerland, with its arcaded waterfront and Santa Maria del Sasso church overlooking the lake.

The route continues through scenic lakeside roads, forest sections and panoramic viewpoints before returning to Lugano. Ideal for road bikes or e-bikes, this tour blends sport, culture and breathtaking views in one unforgettable ride.
highlights: Lakeside cycling around Lake Lugano
Morcote, one of Switzerland’s most beautiful villages
Melide & Bissone scenic waterfront
Italian coffee in the charming village of Porto Ceresio
Panoramic viewpoints of the Gulf of Lugano

title: Dolomites Bike & Camper Experience
subtitle: 5 Days | Self-Guided Cycling Adventure through the Italian Dolomites
intro: Explore one of the most spectacular mountain regions in Europe combining cycling with the freedom of van-life travel. The Dolomites Bike & Camper Experience allows you to ride some of the most iconic alpine roads and scenic valleys in the Italian Dolomites while traveling with a fully equipped campervan.
Designed for 1 to 4 riders, this self-guided program can be adapted to different riding styles — from road cycling and gravel exploration to relaxed e-bike scenic rides.

Instead of following a rigid daily itinerary, the experience offers a curated selection of recommended rides across the Dolomites. Each day you can choose the route that best matches the weather conditions, your energy levels and the terrain you want to explore.
highlights: Ride some of the most iconic alpine roads in Europe
Climb legendary Dolomite passes like Passo Gardena, Pordoi and Sella
Discover scenic valleys such as Val di Funes with the dramatic Odle peaks
Reach the famous Lago di Braies, one of the most photographed lakes in the Alps
Combine cycling adventure with the freedom of van-life travel

title: Enduro Alps Experience — Airolo, Ritom & Nara
subtitle: 3-day enduro MTB adventure across bike parks, alpine passes and wild trails
intro: A three-day high-alpine enduro journey across some of Ticino’s most iconic riding zones: Airolo Bike Park, Lago Ritom (Passo del Sole area) and Nara Bike Park.

Designed for experienced riders, this program blends lift-assisted flow trails, remote alpine traverses and long, technical natural and prepared descents. Each day offers a different character — from bike park progression to wild sunrise missions in high mountain terrain.
This is a physically demanding and technically challenging experience built for riders seeking intensity, skill development and true alpine immersion.
highlights: Lift-assisted riding at Airolo Bike Park
Sunrise traverse above Lago Ritom
High-alpine Passo del Sole descent
Long technical lines in Nara Bike Park
Multi-day progression & pure enduro focus

title: Lugano Bike Ride Tour
subtitle: 2 Days | Scenic Alpine Roads & Lake Views
intro: A two-day guided road cycling escape across the Lugano region, blending smooth lakeside riding, rolling countryside and sustained alpine climbs.

Starting in Lugano, we follow the shores of Lake Lugano toward the Italian border near Porto Ceresio, before climbing into the green hills of Malcantone. On Day 2, the route heads toward the panoramic roads of Valcolla, offering sustained ascents and sweeping mountain views.
Designed for cyclists who want performance riding with comfort, the experience includes accommodation, meals and relaxed aperitivi to close each day.
A compact yet complete road cycling weekend in the heart of Ticino.
highlights: Scenic lakeside roads around Lake Lugano
Cross-border riding to Porto Ceresio
Rolling Malcantone countryside
Alpine ascent toward Valcolla
Hotel stay, gastronomy & aperitivo moments

title: Passo del Pradecolo & Alpone di Curiglia
subtitle: 2 Days | E-bike journey from Lake Lugano to Lake Maggiore
intro: A panoramic cross-lake adventure linking Lake Lugano with Lake Maggiore through forest climbs, mountain passes and quiet borderland roads.

Starting from Lugano, we ride south along the lake on a beautiful cycle path. From there, we begin climbing on quiet gravel roads, passing through traditional Ticino villages and into the scenic mountain area of Passo del Pradecolo. Here, we stay overnight immersed in alpine nature, with stunning views over Lake Maggiore and Monte Rosa.
The second day continues by riding on spectacular forest wide gravel track, then passing through the rural stone-made towns toward Lake Maggiore.
Designed for e-bike riders who want distance, elevation and discovery without sacrificing comfort.
highlights: Cross-border ride Switzerland → Italy
Mountain ascent to Passo del Pradecolo and Passo della Forcora
Overnight stay in comfortable alpine lodge setting
Long panoramic descent to Lake Maggiore
Authentic, generous Italian cuisine served in a charming alpine lodge.

title: San Lucio & Monte Bar Alpine Traverse
subtitle: High-altitude MTB / e-bike adventure across Ticino’s wild ridgelines
intro: A true alpine experience linking two iconic mountain locations: San Lucio Pass and Monte Bar.

This tour takes you deep into the wilder side of Lugano, far from the lakeside crowds. Starting with a steady climb (or shuttle-assisted option), we reach the historic San Lucio Pass — a scenic border crossing between Switzerland and Italy surrounded by alpine meadows, panoramic peaks with two typical alpine restaurants.

From there, we traverse spectacular ridgelines and well maintained single trails toward Monte Bar, one of the most panoramic summits in the Lugano region. This is a challenging tour, with plenty of adventure and technical sections. Every single meter of effort is rewarded by stunning views as you ride along the ridgeline.
This is not just a ride; if you love capturing your adventures with your camera or phone, this is perfect for you as it’s the most photogenic bike tour experience in the Lugano region.
highlights: Summit area of Monte Brè
Historic San Lucio Pass
Summit views from Monte Bar
Alpine ridgeline riding
Cross-border mountain atmosphere
Wild landscapes & remote trails
Alpine hut with local and genuine food

title: Giro dell’Etna – Sicily Bikepacking
subtitle: 5 Days | Around Europe’s Highest Active Volcano
intro: A five-day cycling expedition around Mount Etna, Europe’s highest active volcano and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

This full circular route blends volcanic deserts, medieval towns, pistachio and orange fields, lava forests and long panoramic climbs toward Etna North. Each stage reveals a different face of Sicily, from fertile countryside to lunar high-altitude terrain above 1,800 meters.
Designed as a multi-stage journey, enjoy the authentic Sicilian hospitality and food, mountain hut atmosphere and lunar landscapes.
This is not just a cycling tour, it is a unforgettable volcanic bike adventure.
highlights: Full loop around Mount Etna
Black lava fields & lunar landscapes
Medieval towns: Centuripe and Bronte
Overnight at high-altitude mountain refuge (~1,740 m)
Sea views from Etna’s eastern slopes
The famous Bronte pistachio
Exquisite Sicilian cuisine

title: Tuscany – Via Francigena
subtitle: 5 Days | From San Miniato to lake Bolsena along the Via Francigena
intro: The Via Francigena from San Miniato to Rome is one of the most iconic cycling journeys in Italy, following the ancient pilgrimage route towards the Eternal City.

This section takes riders through the heart of Tuscany and into Lazio, crossing rolling hills, vineyards, cypress-lined roads and historic villages. From the Tuscan countryside to the volcanic landscapes near Viterbo, each stage offers a unique mix of scenery, culture and riding.
The terrain is varied and engaging, combining quiet secondary roads and sections of gravel, making it ideal for riders seeking an authentic and immersive experience.
More than just a ride, this journey is about the experience of reaching Rome — a rewarding and memorable finish to one of Europe’s most historic routes.
highlights: Ride one of Europe’s most iconic pilgrimage routes
From the heart of Tuscany to Europe’s largest volcanic lake, Bolsena.
Rolling hills, vineyards and cypress-lined roads
Unique mix of asphalt and gravel sections
Medieval villages and historic landmarks along the way
Authentic Italian food and local culture at every stage
Memorable finish riding into Rome

title: Uganda – Bike Adventure & Wildlife Safari
subtitle: 12 Days | Safari and biking in the Heart of Africa
intro: Discover Uganda on an extraordinary 12-day adventure combining 5 days of cycling with unforgettable wildlife safaris, gorilla trekking and authentic African experiences. Ride through lush green hills, remote villages and breathtaking landscapes, discovering the country far beyond the usual tourist routes.

Beyond the bike, explore Uganda’s incredible wildlife and natural wonders. From the powerful Murchison Falls and the savannahs of Queen Elizabeth National Park to a once-in-a-lifetime encounter with mountain gorillas in Bwindi Forest. A unique journey combining adventure, nature, culture and discovery.
highlights: Unforgettable Wildlife Safaris – Discover elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, lions and more across Uganda’s spectacular national parks.
Mountain Gorilla Encounter – Trek through Bwindi Impenetrable Forest and observe endangered mountain gorillas in their natural habitat.
Spectacular Waterfalls & Lakes – Experience the mighty Murchison Falls, cruise the Nile and discover the beautiful islands of Lake Bunyonyi.
Authentic Local Encounters – Discover Uganda’s culture, traditional villages and local communities beyond the typical tourist experience.
